idea-plugin.name: Code-AI
idea-plugin.description:
Drive the Code-AI agent from Android Studio and other IntelliJ-based IDEs. Ships the agent with it: no Python, no install.
  • The same chat panel as the VS Code extension, in a tool window.
  • The agent's edits in the IDE's own diff viewer as they are written, and every file it changed in the conversation to review or revert.
  • The file you have open, your selection and the other open files travel with what you ask.
